U3-err-connector.keychain_refused.en: Your Mac's keychain didn't let Clauseo use your saved case-law sign-in, so nothing changed. Press Allow on Your keychain, then choose Always Allow, and try again.
U3-err-connector.keychain_refused.hi: आपके Mac के कीचेन ने Clauseo को निर्णय खोजने के लिए सहेजा गया साइन-इन उपयोग नहीं करने दिया, इसलिए कुछ नहीं बदला। Your keychain पर Allow दबाएँ, फिर Always Allow चुनें, और दोबारा प्रयास करें।
U3-err-connector.keychain_refused.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
U3-err-connector.keychain_refused.note: connector.keychain_refused (#1348): a Case Law Sign in, Sign out or Add key (Mac only; never Remove) couldn't read, write or delete its saved sign-in, so nothing changed. Shown in Settings › Connectors while the keychain row is granted or not listed; while it reads would_ask or denied, the pointer (UC-1440) and its Allow stand in its place.
